metadata.source: https://www.motodealers.co.uk/bikes/harley-davidson/sportster-iron-883/2018/specs (bore x stroke, compression 9.0:1, about 53 hp and 52 lb-ft)
metadata.notes: Bore 76.2 x 96.8 mm, about 883 cc, compression 9.0:1 and about 53 hp / 52 lb-ft are from the Iron 883 listing. Rod ratio, redline (estimate), valve timing and lift, gear ratios, primary and final drive, masses and flywheel are simulator estimates. 45 degree V-twin with one shared crank pin: firing at 0 and 315 degrees, so the pulses are uneven (315 and 405).
